{{Top|leg}}
The '''Street of Glory''' was a street within [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] that led close to [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], while Theed was occupied by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]], an abandoned building on the Street of Glory was used as a prison to house several of Naboo's citizens, including [[Minister of Culture/Legends|Minister of Culture]] [[Kyu Tane]] and his wife. The prisoners were eventually sprung by members of the [[Naboo Underground]].
